About Galaxy Petrochem

Galaxy Petrochemical is a recognized industry leader providing premium lubrication solutions for heavy machinery, automotive fleets, manufacturing plants, and industrial processing units. With over 6+ years of specialized expertise and 500+ satisfied clients, we offer authorized products from leading brands including Valvoline and ASV Molysulf.

Our comprehensive product range includes hydraulic oils (such as Enklo 68 and Servo 68 equivalents), zinc-free lubricants, industrial greases, and eco-friendly chemical formulations.
